title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29642: add Inventory Valuation events
summary: Inventory Valuation report 10139 now exposes two integration events to let extensions skip items and adjust Value Entry filters, matching the W1 report's extensibility.
key_points: New publisher in the OnAfterGetRecord trigger of NA report 10139 lets subscribers skip an item
New publisher in AdjustItemLedgEntryToAsOfDate, after the initial Value Entry filters, lets subscribers refine those filters
Both publishers mirror the W1 Inventory Valuation report so extensions built against W1 can compile on North America
quote: Extensions can skip an item and adjust Value Entry filters in its equivalent processing flow.
